_comment: Vanguard — the Front-Aura (content pass C5, plan-content-zones12.md §A): the game's FIRST SANCTIONED POWER OUTLIER, the 'endgame-gear equivalent' as a spellbook entry. Deliberately overstrong multi-effect: full Damage numbers at DOUBLE targets, full Heal numbers with NO self-cost (the base aura pays 18 HP), plus a modest shield on allies AND self (toned down from RallyDrum-class — PO in-game pass 2026-07-18: the reapplying overshield read way too strong; cut again C8 walkthrough 2026-07-20: 13/s self-absorb made AFK-facetanking Z1/Z2 content free — now ~2.7 HP/s at max) — damage and heal ~100% of their dedicated base skills, INVERTING the Paladin ~70% combo calibration and the §4 side-grade rule (named exception, not precedent erosion — GDD §4/§5 amendments ride this chunk). Taught by the Front NPC at L20 (PO 2026-07-18: the journey's final step in v1). Sets the power ceiling: everything else balances below it (C8); C7 combos it with Damage / Heal / a Burst cooldown into the game's best-in-slot trio. All values [PLACEHOLDER]
name: Vanguard
